messages:
hana (People Ops): Welcome Alex! Quick pre-Day-1 checklist: I-9 remote agent, background check follow-up (vendor flagged name variant), laptop delivery estimate, benefits enrollment window, payroll setup. Any blockers?

alex.r (New Hire): Thanks — I'm remote (OR). I have passport and state ID. Also FYI my legal name on some old documents is Alexander R., vendor said mismatch.

bg-vendor-bot: Background check status: INFO_REQUIRED — name variation detected between SSN trace and submitted docs. Vendor emailed alex.r@personal.mail for affidavit or supporting docs.

hana (People Ops): Alex, please upload a signed affidavit explaining the name variant or provide previous paystub/lease with the alternate name. I can also submit a notarized statement if you prefer. Use secure intake: https://okta.redwood.com/i9-upload

alex.r (New Hire): I just uploaded a scanned paystub from 2018 showing Alexander R. — should that clear it?

bg-vendor-bot: Vendor update: DOCUMENT_RECEIVED — review in progress. Expect resolution within 24 hours.

it (IT): Laptop shipped (MacBook Air M2). Courier ETA Fri 5pm PT. Tracking: https://ship.example/TT9988. Note: please complete device policy acceptance prompt once you get the device.

buddy-jen: I'll be Alex's buddy — planning a 30-min intro next Tue. I'll post a short Day-1 agenda in #welcome-alex.

nina (Benefits): Benefits enrollment: https://benefits.redwood.com/start — enroll within 30 days. If you need to add dependents retroactively to start date, email benefits@redwood.com within 7 days.

sam (Hiring Manager): Access requests: GitHub + Slack approved. Alex, expect AWS dev read-only for first week until infra onboarding complete.

it (IT): Provisioning done for Slack/GitHub. AWS access pending infra checklist completion. Credentials will be shared via 1Password.

alex.r (New Hire): Thanks all — uploaded affidavit and paystub. Will watch for device and complete direct deposit/tax forms tonight.

hana (People Ops): Great — tracking: I-9 agent workflow, BG vendor pending, laptop en route, benefits link sent, buddy assigned. I'll follow up if vendor needs more. Welcome! :tada:
